items.title: This week the archive captured 24 open-weight model releases, including tencent's Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B in FP8, GGUF, and Interleave variants, plus inclusionAI's Ling-3.0-flash and Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree. openbmb added GPTQ and int4 builds of MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and internlm released Atria-Dawn with an FP8 version. No mirrors or alerts were recorded; radar signals included a DeepInfer inference framework for DeepSeek models on HN's front page and a DHS order banning DeepSeek from U.S. federal civilian agencies.
